Region assignment of Beeho Yoo vs Steve Miller conflicts: the MAME history says Miller appears only with the USA territory setting; the BakaOrochi FAQ says Miller in Japan/US and Yoo in Europe; Ultimate Future Games' Japanese-titled page shows S. MILLER. Left unresolved in the article.
Whether you must tap A while charging conflicts: Arcade Quartermaster/FAQ say tap or mash; the Windjammers France wiki says the charge is automatic.
The BakaOrochi FAQ claims a set past 12 points continues until someone leads by more than 2. That conflicts with Wikipedia's simple 12-point rule, was not verified, and is omitted from the article.

Arcade ladder length: Hardcore Gamer (PS4) says it includes a clone of yourself and MAN!AC 5/94 OCR says five other players; exact count of matches in the original was not verified from primary material.

Edge #10 5/10, Famitsu 28/40 and the other scores in Wikipedia's table were not verified: the archive.org Edge_UK_010 item is dark, and the MAN!AC 5/94 page image failed to download (OCR text only, score unreadable).
Hardcore Gamer's claim that EGM and GamePro gave no proper review was not independently checked against magazine scans.
Hardcore Gamer's 4/5 is taken from the site's current rating box and may be a post-migration display of the original score.
Nothing tested: launch, emulator performance, button mapping, half-circle reliability on a D-pad, difficulty/DIP settings and two-player play.
Court identification of the lead image as 'tiled' is inferred from its goal colour layout matching the FAQ/wiki description, not from an on-screen label.
